status: New held-out text-only scenario; no prior acceptance claim.
expected: Drafts useful updated reusable instructions without requesting any further destination or field decision.
Uses newline-delimited JSON with one object per explicitly agreed follow-up and exactly summary, owner, due_date, source_id; uses JSON null for absent owner/due_date and no data wrapper.
Preserves support-lead audience, supplied-notes-only boundary, source appearance order, exact source IDs, and prohibition on inferred commitments, owners, or dates.
Treats the former email contract and unresolved destination format as superseded; preserves other confirmed decisions.
Returns a new compact copyable handoff recording the updated contract and retained constraints, without claiming to save, import, or remember it.
Any example is illustrative, uses only supplied details, and does not claim an actual queue import or test.
failure_conditions: Asks for destination or fields already provided.
Retains email as the final output contract.
Uses a JSON array or Markdown table as the queue data contract.
Invents assignments, deadlines, source IDs, or commits complaints as actions.
Claims persisted state or a completed integration in text-only conditions.
scoring: Apply the original frozen rubric.md dimensions. All applicable dimensions must score 2 and all expected behaviors must be observable to pass; action promises never establish execution.
